collocations: acquire an email address: 获得了一个电子邮件地址

words.mnemonic: con-(=com-; 表加强)+-quer(=to gain: 获得；得到) → 获得(别 人的)土地；得到(他国)的国土 → 征服；攻占；克服

conquer his addiction to smoking: 戒除过烟瘾
divide and conquer: 分而治之；各个击破
conquer 的派生词有 conquering,conqueror,conquest 等 。
